summary: Re-verification PASSED after two cosmetic edits following iteration_104. NO regression. All 5 requested flows work on the Expo web preview at 390x844: (1) cold start renders the Login screen with SERTEX header, Kullanıcı adı + Şifre inputs, and GİRİŞ YAP button (NOT blank/white — the previously suspected blank-screen artifact did not reproduce with proper wait_for_selector on login-email-input); (2) serkan/19071987 successfully navigates to /tasks and 17 tasks render under 3 category sections (Fason Verme 2/5, Kargolama 0/0, Kategorisiz 1/12) matching header 'GÖREVLER · 3/17 tamamlandı'; (3) task checkbox toggle round-trip (PATCH /api/tasks/{id}) works — pill state updates optimistically and reverts on cancel-toggle; (4) NEW: typing a no-match query ('zzzznoexistqueryxxxx') now correctly hides all category headers and renders tasks-empty-state with 'Sonuç bulunamadı' + 'Farklı bir arama terimi deneyin' — the cosmetic action item from iteration_104 is fixed; (5) Profile tab shows serkan / Yönetici and the Çıkış Yap (logout) button returns to /login. Regression check: the RN Web 'shadow*' deprecation console warning is GONE (login button shadow* props were removed as claimed). Only the 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning remains — non-blocking, originates from RN Web / Expo Router internals (not user-code).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning still emitted once during login submit: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Origin appears to be RN Web / Expo Router internals — no user-code offender found in mobile source. Non-blocking; likely resolved by future RN Web / Expo SDK bump.

critical_code_review_comments: showEmpty condition in /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/tasks.tsx:144 now = 'nodes.length === 0 || visibleCount === 0' which correctly falls back to the empty state when a search matches zero tasks — verified live.

Login button style in /app/mobile/app/login.tsx:181-190 no longer contains shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset — the 'shadow*' deprecation console warning no longer appears at boot/login. Confirmed via captured console log.
No new regressions observed in login → tasks → profile → logout flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile V1 (login + tasks + profile) remains fully green on Expo web preview https://sertex-enterprise.expo.preview.emergentagent.com at viewport 390x844. Both cosmetic edits from iteration_104 action items are verified: (a) tasks empty-state now triggers on no-match search (tests-empty-state visible, category headers hidden), (b) login-button shadow* deprecation warning silenced. Only remaining console warning is 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' — from RN Web internals, not user code, non-blocking. Single-session caveat still applies: mobile login as serkan rotates any active serkan token. Task toggle uses PATCH /api/tasks/{id} with optimistic UI + revert on ApiError.
rca of the issue: n/a — regression check confirmed no regressions and both cosmetic fixes working as designed.
